text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the day off! Thanks to you, I 
got to talk a lot with my big sisters."
choice_data_list: Were your big sisters doing well?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My big jie-jie was delighted that 
Mama approved her suit design, and—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"My second sister in Ireland looked so 
happy too, saying she won a prestigious 
race!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I need to make sure I have good news 
to report, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown enjoyed her phone call with 
her sister and seemed to have spent a 
meaningful day off!
